basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/DecTrax/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. The [DECTRAX](https://dectrax.com) solution delivers automated, high-fidelity threat intelligence, active deception honeypot telemetry, and zero-trust gateway blocks directly into your Log Analytics workspace. **Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:** a. [Codeless Connector Framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector) b. [Azure Monitor Log Analytics](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/logs/log-analytics-overview) **Data Connectors:** 1, **Parsers:** 1, **Workbooks:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 4, **Hunting Queries:** 2 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

metadata.hidden: Hiding location, we get it from the log analytics workspace

basics.name: getLAWorkspace
basics.toolTip: This filters by workspaces that exist in the Resource Group selected

basics.name: workspace
basics.label: Workspace
basics.toolTip: This dropdown will list only workspace that exists in the Resource Group selected

subLabel.preValidation: Configure your DECTRAX API endpoint and authentication token.

elements.name: apiEndpoint
elements.label: DECTRAX API Endpoint URL
elements.toolTip: Enter your DECTRAX Threat Intelligence API URL.

constraints.validationMessage: Please provide a valid DECTRAX API Endpoint URL.

elements.name: apiKey
elements.toolTip: Enter your secure DECTRAX API Bearer Token.

constraints.validationMessage: DECTRAX API Bearer Token must be at least 12 characters long.

elements.name: enableDataConnector
elements.label: Enable Codeless REST API Data Connector
elements.toolTip: Enables automatic scheduled polling of DECTRAX threat feeds directly into your Sentinel workspace.

subLabel.preValidation: Select detection rules, workbooks, and hunting queries to deploy.

options.text: Select the security artifacts you wish to deploy alongside the DECTRAX integration:

elements.name: enableAnalyticRules
elements.label: Deploy Pre-configured Sentinel Analytic Detection Rules (4 Rules)
elements.toolTip: Deploys MITRE ATT&CK-mapped Scheduled Alert Rules: High Severity Honeypot Breach, Volumetric Recon/Scan, GATE Zero-Trust Threat Intercept, and SCADA/BMS Protocol Tampering.

elements.name: enableWorkbooks
elements.label: Deploy DECTRAX Threat Intelligence & Deception Dashboard Workbook
elements.toolTip: Deploys an interactive multi-tab Azure Monitor/Sentinel Workbook with attack geolocations, protocol breakdowns, honeypot sensor status, and attacker IP analytics.

elements.name: enableHuntingQueries
elements.label: Deploy Threat Hunting Saved Searches & ASIM Parsers
elements.toolTip: Deploys Log Analytics Saved Searches and ASIM normalization parser functions for advanced threat hunting.
